name: design-game-studio
description: Design, develop, refine, and test playable 2D, 3D, browser, narrative, and mobile games with engine-aware skills and game-specific quality workflows.

interface.longDescription: Design Game Studio helps create, improve, and test playable 2D, 3D, browser, narrative, and mobile games. It chooses appropriate engines, designs achievable gameplay loops, plans consistent visuals and licensed assets, and guides real implementation, playtesting, optimization, and release handoffs. It works with Phaser, PlayCanvas, Godot, Ren’Py and suitable Unity/Unreal projects. Coding, engine execution, asset creation and multi-agent delegation depend on the tools actually available in the host; this skills-only plugin does not itself supply a game-building cloud service or hosted previews.
capabilities: Turn game ideas into scoped playable projects
Guide Unity, Unreal, Ren’Py and mobile workflows
Define coherent game art and licensed asset pipelines
Design levels, gameplay systems and controls
Playtest, debug and prepare game releases
defaultPrompt: Build a playable 2D game from this idea. Choose an engine, implement the core loop, and run the tests available.
Create a stylized 3D exploration game with clear objectives, consistent visuals, and verified controls.
Improve this existing game project: diagnose issues, implement the requested change, and check for regressions.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.2: Renamed to Design Game Studio; retained the user-selected icon, 21 skills, 16 references, and existing workflows.
